purpose: Turn discovery records into a prioritized, permission-gated acquisition work queue. This queue does not authorize downloads.
hard_gates: Do not fetch a source until the exact access terms and acquisition method have been reviewed.
Do not mark collection_permission=allowed without documented evidence covering the intended acquisition method and use.
Do not treat a source's public availability as permission for automated retrieval, commercial use, indexing, or display.
Preserve the original acquired file unchanged and record SHA-256, final URL, retrieval timestamp, response metadata, Gazette issue, publication date, and page range.
Keep legal status and lawyer review separate from source acquisition and OCR/extraction status.
Do not automatically merge OCR output or an unofficial consolidation into the trusted current-law corpus.

priority_definitions.P0: Foundational and time-sensitive legislation needed for a reliable MVP; start permission/terms work first.
priority_definitions.P1: High-value coverage for common lawyer workflows after P0 acquisition is underway.
priority_definitions.P2: Specialist or broader coverage; queue after higher-priority foundational materials.
priority_definitions.blocked: No automated collection until permission or source terms are resolved.

queue.action: Request licensed API, official export or written exception before automated acquisition or commercial indexing of judgments. In the meantime, retain citation metadata and manually entered judgments only where their provenance and rights are documented.

required_evidence: approved acquisition method and rate limits

next_decisions: Obtain written confirmation or a license from the relevant official publishers for storage, extraction, search indexing, commercial product use, and display.
Choose a first acquisition batch only after permission is documented; do not run the downloader against this queue as-is.
Where automated acquisition is blocked, use authorized manual document supply and record the permission evidence.
Do not represent the inventory as coverage-complete; update the coverage matrix only when source documents and amendment chains are verified.
